verdict.rationale: Jules's docs state that it runs in a virtual machine where it clones your code and installs dependencies on its own. The cloud VM serves as its working environment, and it reads AGENTS.md from the repo root for guidance. A community user notes that bespoke, machine-specific build setups don't carry over to the cloud VM, which is a limit on how far the environment can be configured. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how Jules configures or customizes its environment (setup scripts, env vars, toolchain selection), independent hands-on corroboration of automatic dependency installation

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent automatically clone the repo, install dependencies, and configure its own working environment

citations.quote: Jules runs in a virtual machine where it clones your code, installs dependencies, and modifies files.
Jules now automatically looks for a file named AGENTS.md in the root of your repository.
